verdict: Paid ads have been off for 19 days; leads and local visibility are down.
narrative: All paid advertising stopped on September 15th, and no leads have been tracked since September 10th — the 2 leads recorded this period both came before that cutoff, entirely through Meta. Google Business Profile actions fell 72% week over week and hit zero for three consecutive days (October 4–6), pointing to reduced local search visibility at the same time paid traffic disappeared. Your CRM shows 181 contacts this period, which does not reconcile with 2 tracked paid leads; we are working to reconnect the pipeline so that contact intake is accurately reflected against campaign activity. Ads are being brought back online this week, and the attribution and tracking repairs that support accurate reporting are in motion alongside that restart. You should see lead flow resume and local profile activity stabilize over the next reporting period.
